title: Reserved example/test origin can reach live publishing
local_evidence: Live publish and workflow generation reject reserved origins; dry-run remains allowed; tests in tests/test_engine.py.
remaining_acceptance: Real remote publish intentionally not executed.

title: Generic repository host policy is too permissive
local_evidence: Generic template requires exact host placeholders; explicit wildcard entries are rejected; P12's strict runtime checks retained.
remaining_acceptance: Omitting allowed_hosts remains backward-compatible unrestricted mode and is documented; decide whether a future strict mode should disallow omission.

title: No project-level .gitignore
local_evidence: Root .gitignore excludes Python caches, .venv, build outputs, local publisher state and test-results.

title: Dev Container verifier accepts weaker toolchain than declared
local_evidence: Verifier requires Python 3.13, active Java 25, installed Java 21, Maven 3.10.0 and Git LFS 3.8.1; config/runtime tests cover wrong/missing versions.
remaining_acceptance: Real Codespaces image build is F16 and remains open.

title: Mutable Dev Container image and package resolution
local_evidence: Workblock 07 preserves the original Git Subtree approach: Debian Bookworm's digest-pinned base image supplies /usr/lib/git-core/git-subtree through package git. The installer verifies dpkg ownership/version and helper SHA-256, symlinks it into git --exec-path, and writes lock v3 with base-image digest, platform, APT snapshot/source hash, Git/package versions and helper link provenance. The Workblock 06 real build failed because it tried to install the nonexistent Debian package git-subtree; the signed snapshot itself downloaded successfully.
remaining_acceptance: Fresh Codespaces rebuild must succeed; verify git subtree -h without GIT_EXEC_PATH, complete all lifecycle checks, then create a second clean build and compare toolchain-lock.tsv byte-for-byte. Do not mark F05/F16 closed until these are accepted.

title: Keycloak smoke fixture mistaken for deploy-ready config
local_evidence: Renamed publisher.keycloak.smoke.yml; explicit smoke-only header and reserved origin; live publishing guard remains active.
remaining_acceptance: No live deployment acceptance is claimed.

title: Workflow/test Python runtime mismatch
local_evidence: Added .github/workflows/python-compatibility.yml with Python 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13 matrix legs; each runs core, manifest/cleanup, wheel-installation and process/timeout tests. A local structural test validates the matrix. Only Python 3.13.5 is installed in the local execution environment.
remaining_acceptance: Run the new GitHub Actions matrix and record a passing result for each supported Python minor version.

title: Environment interpolation not exhaustively constrained
local_evidence: Unsupported/unexpanded ${NAME} references rejected; exact supported environment paths and pass/secret allowlists tested.
remaining_acceptance: Environment-dependent integrations still require provider/CI acceptance.

title: Provider labels do not select actual provider adapters
local_evidence: provider_label is metadata only; aliases cannot conflict; local tests prove label changes do not alter generated URLs.
remaining_acceptance: GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket-specific adapters are not implemented; generic template behavior only.

title: Private target is self-attested rather than verified
local_evidence: private_target_attested is explicit operator assertion; legacy alias conflicts and non-security use rejected.
remaining_acceptance: Actual endpoint visibility, authentication, membership and ACL must be checked externally by the operator/provider.

title: Dynamic Communication fields were under-modelled
local_evidence: Schema, semantic validation, component/global channel tests and 14 relationship records added; channel/query naming and email-versus-URL contracts enforced.
remaining_acceptance: No complete real-browser/end-end acceptance for each provider/channel; all N/A pair cases remain unverified.

title: Default CLI configuration absent from a fresh clone
local_evidence: Added documentation-publisher init-config. It copies the packaged generic fail-closed template (or an explicit regular template); exclusive create; no overwrite; symlink/.git/missing-parent protections. Tests cover positive, no-overwrite, custom template, missing parent and .git safety; installed-wheel test runs it outside checkout.
remaining_acceptance: Run once in the user target GitHub repository after archive import; replace placeholders. The command deliberately does not guess owner/repo/branch/provider/credentials.

title: Historical reports mixed into project root
local_evidence: Old P1/P2/P3/P11/P12 reports and test outputs moved unchanged under audit/history; root STATUS.md is the sole current status; archive inventory and lineage index added.
remaining_acceptance: Library archives outside the project remain retained as historical objects; use only the latest reconciled Group 3 archive.

title: No installable Python package metadata or console entry point
local_evidence: Added PEP 621 pyproject.toml, PEP 517 wheel, runtime/dev extras, package data and documentation-publisher console entry point. Wheel includes schema/template/provider registry; runtime schema loaded with importlib.resources; wheel test installs in temp venv and invokes console script/init-config/capabilities outside checkout. The test also runs validate-config against the installed Keycloak smoke config from outside the checkout, proving the package schema resource is used.
remaining_acceptance: Windows/macOS wheel installation and approved package-index release were not performed; development version only.
